text: `pyproject.toml` defines a setuptools build with `requires = ["setuptools>=68", "wheel"]` and `build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"`, and sets project metadata to `name = "outcomegraph"`, `version = "0.1.0"`, `description = "OutcomeGraph CLI and artifact reconciliation workflow"`, `readme = "README.md"`, and `requires-python = ">=3.11"`.
